notes: Arm travel no longer moves on a single glitched frame — the arm-swing number is now a sustained range, confirmed by at least two frames, like the rest of the sprint numbers already are. One frame misreading a wrist used to report a big arm swing and score 100 on arm rhythm, hiding arms that never swung, and could even read a still clip as an arm-swing drill. A real swing held across frames still scores the same.
